run_finetune_1_percent: run the semisupervised fine-tuning script on 1 percent of ImageNet labels with a pretrained SwAV model
run_finetune_10_percent: run the semisupervised fine-tuning script on 10 percent of ImageNet labels with a pretrained SwAV model
train_model: train the ResNet50 model on a subset of ImageNet using SGD with dual learning rates for trunk and head
validate_network: validate the fine-tuned model on the full ImageNet validation set and track best top-1 accuracy
load_pretrained_weights: load pretrained SwAV weights into a ResNet50 model with automatic module prefix removal and shape mismatch handling
